dataset_name: Sentinel-1 Oil Spill External (Singapore Strait / Malacca Strait, 4 scenes)
source: Procedural SAR generator (ml/data/generate_sar_dataset.py); no real Sentinel-1 imagery
geographic_coverage: Singapore Strait East, Malacca Strait West
notes:
Used exclusively for Phase 19 cross-dataset generalization. Ships are present in
imagery but not labeled; mask class 3 is never generated — object-level metrics
for vessels are therefore not supported on this or the primary dataset.
